verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents multivariate flags with percentage weightings (A/B/n), a dedicated Experimentation feature that serves variations, collects events into a managed data warehouse, and reads results via a built-in Bayesian statistics engine, plus GitHub docs confirming A/B and multivariate testing via segments. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the statistics engine's accuracy and no detail on specific metric definition/goal-setting workflow in the pack.
